snippet.title: Canvas Infernum | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Canvas Infernum
Shape Hell according to your morals by placing tiles with real artwork, or become eternally damned. Craft a masterpiece to last forever and keep Satan from fading from human memory. Discover countless combos, forge bonds with demon lords, and unveil the mysteries of a strategy roguelike penance.
